basic_profile.bio: A 28-year-old trans woman living in Asheville, NC. By day, I work as a software engineer specializing in front-end development. In the evenings and weekends, you can find me hiking in the Great Smoky Mountains or playing retro video games. I'm a big fan of music, particularly genres that bridge the gap between old-school rock and modern pop. I often spend my online hours late at night, enjoying the stillness to catch up on my favorite subreddits. I've been in a committed relationship for the past two years with a fellow nature enthusiast.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science from a state university. Over the years, I've honed my skills in software development through both professional experience and personal projects. I've also developed a keen interest in linguistics and etymology, which is why I frequent subreddits like uncommonwords.
